 Crystal ball helps see Frederick Richard clear to world floor exercise title
 By John Crumlish and IG Online Staff
 Saturday, October 24, 2026
 Frederick Richard (USA) 
 Fresh from winning floor exercise gold at the World Championships in Rotterdam on Saturday, Frederick Richard of the U.S. told International Gymnast Online of a crystal ball whose supernatural message – combined with his own natural efforts – guided him to victory.
 “There’s a special shop where someone told me I had a chance at winning gold if I just worked hard every day, and that’s what I did,” said Richard of the mystical orb he bought in a shop in Ann Arbor, Michigan, where he competed and studied at the University of Michigan. “But I can’t reveal where. It’s my secret and hopefully it gets me plenty more in the future.
